title: soc2-prep-scratchpad-ethan-park
content:
SOC2 prep scratchpad - Ethan

Purpose: working notes for control mapping + risk Qs + action items. Not final.

High-level to-do:
- Finish control mapping draft for CC2 (Change Management) and CC6 (Monitoring) by next week (meet w/ infra + SRE).
- Confirm evidence locations (audit logs, retention windows) for Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Identify owners for each control (primary + backup).
- Run through sample evidence collection for two customers (case: acme-corp, beta).

Open questions / uncertainties:
- CC6: do we have centralized alerting proof for Hosted API vs Dedicated customer-owned infra? Need statement for Private deploys (on-prem) where customer manages network.
- Logging retention: default retention in prod is 90 days for request traces, but compliance asks for 12 months for certain controls. Are we ok with export + archival flow? (see infra ticket ENG-4321)
- Key management: KMS integration docs exist but need evidence of HSM usage for Private high-compliance customers. Who owns that? (cc: Lena Morales)

Control mapping (rough, mapping id -> evidence / owner / status):
- CC2.1 change control: mapping -> GitHub PR + code review + changelog entry. Owner: eng-platform. Evidence: PR history, release notes. Status: partial (missing policy doc).
- CC2.4 emergency changes: mapping -> incident postmortem + emergency change log. Owner: SRE. Evidence: postmortem archive. Status: needs formal emergency change policy.
- CC6.2 monitoring & alerting: mapping -> Datadog dashboards + PagerDuty runbooks. Owner: site-reliability-engineering. Evidence: screenshots, runbook links. Status: mostly covered for Hosted; Dedicated/Private gaps.
- CC7.1 access provisioning/deprovisioning: mapping -> Okta sync logs + onboarding checklist. Owner: ppl-ops + security. Evidence: Okta audit, HR termination flow doc. Status: draft.

Sample evidence list (what we need to assemble):
- PR list filter: label:soc2-evidence, date range last 12 months (owner: eng-release).
- Datadog alert definitions export (json) + associated runbooks (owner: SRE).
- Okta admin audit log extract (owner: security).
- KMS key rotation logs + policy (owner: infra/cryptography).
- Deployment pipeline artifact retention policy + storage proof (owner: release-eng).

Immediate action items (this week):
- [ ] Sync w/ Lena on KMS/HSM evidence (Fri 10am) - meeting scheduled
- [ ] Pull PRs tagged soc2-evidence (ask eng-release to add label automation)
- [ ] Draft emergency change policy (short) and share with SRE for review
- [ ] Confirm log retention export path for 12mo archive (ops)

Meeting notes (2026-02-18 call w/ SRE + Infra):
- SRE: Datadog alert coverage is good for Hosted; Dedicated customers get separate orgs — need cross-walk doc.
- Infra: For Private on-prem we provide deployment manifest + install guide; cannot attest to customer's monitoring unless they opt-in to managed service. We can provide recommended configuration and sample runbook.
- Action: create a "gap" table to surface controls we cannot fully evidence for Private model; propose compensating controls (e.g., install checklist, baseline config, audit hooks). Owner: Ethan (due 2026-02-24).

Draft language snippets for evidence request emails to teams/customers:
- "Hi team — we're assembling SOC2 evidence for internal audit. Could you please export and attach Okta admin audit logs for users in group 'redwood-prod-admin' for the period 2025-03-01 to 2026-02-28?"
- "For Dedicated customers, please provide confirmation of monitoring integration and retention policy or export of alert definitions used for production environments."

Risks & notes:
- Risk: Private deployments create unavoidable evidence gaps (we must be explicit about shared responsibility). Need legal review on customer-facing language.
- Risk: tagging/label hygiene in GitHub is inconsistent; may miss PR evidence. Consider automation to tag releases/PRs that touch infra/config.

Ideas / long-term improvements:
- Add a small SOC2 checklist to PR template for infra/config changes (checkboxes).
- Auto-tag PRs deploying infra/config with soc2-evidence via CI job when release pipeline runs.
- Centralized evidence bucket with one-click exports for auditors (S3 export job).

References / links:
- Confluence: SOC2 Prep Home (https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/SOC2+Prep+Home)
- Jira: ENG-4321 (logging retention followup)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/987 (example of change with release note)

Notes to self:
- Keep this doc lightweight; move finalized mappings to Confluence once stable.
- Ask legal to draft customer-facing shared-responsibility blurb for Private deployments.

End of scratchpad.
